hooks.command: PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; w="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/claude-hooks/at-root.sh"; c='command -v enola >/dev/null 2>&1 && enola hook session-start || :'; if [ -f "$w" ]; then exec bash "$w" sh -c "$c"; else cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}")" || exit 0; exec sh -c "$c"; fi

PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; w="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/claude-hooks/at-root.sh"; c='[ -f quality/bin/gate.py ] || exit 0; exec python3 quality/bin/gate.py --guard'; if [ -f "$w" ]; then exec bash "$w" sh -c "$c"; else cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}")" || exit 0; exec sh -c "$c"; fi

PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; w="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/scripts/claude-hooks/at-root.sh"; c='[ -f quality/bin/gate.py ] || exit 0; exec python3 quality/bin/gate.py --hook --changed'; if [ -f "$w" ]; then exec bash "$w" sh -c "$c"; else cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}")" || exit 0; exec sh -c "$c"; fi
